title: Harissa squid with aubergine
summary: Harissa squid with aubergine is a middle eastern dinner built around squid rings and aubergines, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Have everything for Harissa squid with aubergine chopped before the pan goes on. Pat squid rings dry and season it.
steps.tip: A short cook only works if the chopping is finished first.

steps.instruction: Heat the oil in a wide pan and cook squid rings until just done. Lift it out.
In the same pan, cook aubergines and rose harissa paste until hot and lightly browned. Return squid rings and toss with the lemon, lime or sauce.
Taste Harissa squid with aubergine, add salt if it needs it, and serve straight away.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
steps.tip: Taste Harissa squid with aubergine before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.
